{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
data = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for duplicates in patient_id
patient_id_counts = data['patient_id'].value_counts()
duplicate_patients = patient_id_counts[patient_id_counts > 1]

# Print basic info
data.info()
print(f"\nNumber of unique patient_ids: {data['patient_id'].nunique()}")
print(f"Number of rows: {len(data)}")
print(f"Number of patients with multiple rows: {len(duplicate_patients)}")
print(f"\nDuplicate patient_ids: {list(duplicate_patients.index)}")

# Check for -999 in biomarker_baseline
print(f"\nNumber of -999 values in biomarker_baseline: {data['biomarker_baseline'].eq(-999).sum()}")

# Check for assay_batch values
print(f"\nAssay batch values: {data['assay_batch'].unique()}")

# Check for arm and severity values
print(f"\nArm values: {data['arm'].unique()}")
print(f"\nSeverity values: {data['severity'].unique()}")

# Check if 'responded' is binary
print(f"\nResponded values and counts: {data['responded'].value_counts().to_dict()}")

# Check if there are control-arm patients with moderate severity
test_df = data[(data['arm'] == 'control') & (data['severity'] == 'moderate')]
print(f"\nControl-arm, moderate-severity patients: {len(test_df)}")

# Check if any of them are duplicated
if len(test_df) > 0:
    test_dupes = test_df['patient_id'].value_counts()
    test_dupes = test_dupes[test_dupes > 1]
    print(f"Duplicate patient_ids in control/moderate group: {list(test_dupes.index)}")
else:
    print("No control-arm, moderate-severity patients found.")"}
